evidence.snippet: We introduce ConVBench, a complex vision-centric reasoning benchmark in which each image is paired with two logically equivalent questions across six categories: action and state, complex counting, spatial reasoning, causal and intent understanding, commonsense reasoning, and temporal perception.

claire_radar.motivation: While Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) exhibit strong perceptual capabilities, they remain vulnerable in visual reasoning tasks.
claire_radar.name: ConVBench
claire_radar.oneLine: ConVBench is a vision-centric reasoning benchmark where each image is paired with two logically equivalent questions across six categories (action/state, complex counting, spatial reasoning, causal/intent, commonsense, temporal perception), with metrics for logical consistency and robust accuracy.
claire_radar.paperTitle: Be Consistent! Enhancing Robust Visual Reasoning in LVLMs with Consistency Constraints

source.title: Be Consistent! Enhancing Robust Visual Reasoning in LVLMs with Consistency Constraints

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Reliable visual reasoning requires not just correctness but consistency; this benchmark measures both, offering a more rigorous test for LVLMs and motivating consistency-aware training methods.
